title: ProjectE production output gate report
description: Fail-closed gate in front of the fabrication outputs, plus the freerouting and CPL/assembly bridges.

gate_verdict.description: The monotone rollup over checks[] that decides whether fabrication output is produced. gate_open is true ONLY for PASS. This used to be 'no check FAILed', which made NO_COVERAGE open the gate and let --skip-verification, --skip-board-checks and a missing artifact contract each produce gerbers off a gate that measured nothing.

gate_open.description: gate_verdict == PASS. Fabrication output exists only when this is true.

excluded_scopes.description: Checks the operator deliberately placed out of scope via --exclude CHECK=REASON, with the reason recorded. Removes a NO_COVERAGE check from the rollup; never suppresses a FAIL.

design.description: The board this report measured, with its digest. REQUIRED: an untieable report is SCREEN_ONLY however good the number in it is. sha256 is null when the path could not be read - loud, not absent.

metrics.description: check name -> violation count, or null when the check measured nothing. Exists because `checks` is a list and the assertion selector grammar addresses a.b paths; without this map a rule can name the tool but cannot point at the check it cares about. NO_COVERAGE is null, NOT 0: a numeric 0 for an unmeasured check compares equal to a threshold and reports PASS on a check that examined nothing - the 0 == 0 agreement drc_gate.py hit on parity_difference_count. The verdict still lives in `checks`.

by_check.description: check name -> {status, scanned, violations}. The name-keyed map that carries COVERAGE, which `metrics` cannot. These are the two halves of one fix and they point in opposite directions: `metrics` is null for an unmeasured check so a threshold comparison CANNOT falsely succeed, and `by_check` lets a rule affirmatively assert that the check ran - `by_check.X.status equals PASS` means ran + examined something + clean, because Finding refuses to build a scanned==0 PASS. Null alone turns a vacuous PASS into a type error, which reads as a broken rule rather than an empty check; by_check alone would leave existing metrics.* bindings comparing 0 to 0. NOTE the denominator is only as honest as the producer: `scanned` must be the population the check actually examined, not a larger set that happens to be non-empty.

$comment: A missing external binary (java, freerouting.jar, kibot, ngspice) is NO_COVERAGE or an error - never a silent PASS. scanned == 0 MUST yield NO_COVERAGE. gate_verdict is that rule made explicit: exit 0 means PASS and nothing else, so NO_COVERAGE can no longer leave through the exit code either.
